messages.subject: Textbook for lavaan (and SEM) opinions?
parts:
my advisor is hoping to migrate his class from LISREL to lavaan as soon as he's done changing his notes. today he showed me this:

http://blogs.baylor.edu/rlatentvariable/

since i'm the only one in my department who uses R as his main (and pretty much only) statistical package, he wanted me to weigh in on whether or not this would be a good supplementary textbook.

i've just started skimming though it and looks good but i wanted to see if other people have used it in the past before?
